description: NaClO₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic Pc space group. The structure is two-dimensional and consists of one NaClO₂ sheet oriented in the (np.int64(1), np.int64(0), np.int64(0)) direction. Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.48 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to two equivalent Na and one Cl atom. The O-Cl bond length is 1.58 Å. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to two equivalent Na and one Cl atom. The O-Cl bond length is 1.59 Å. Cl is bonded in a water-like geometry to two O atoms.
